• Shift in time
   j  t  
f t  t0  e 0 F 
Does not change magnitude of the Fourier transform
Shifts phase of Fourier transform by -t0
(so t0 is the slope of the linear phase)

 



 
 
F f (t  t0)   f (u)ej  (ut0)du  e j  t0  f (u)e j  udu  ej  t0 F()
 

[1] Kaynak: lsarSist-H8_FourierTransform.pdf, sayfa 12
Sinuzoidal Genlik Modülasyonu
(Sinusoidal Amplitude Modulation)
y(t) = f(t) cos(ω0 t)
Multiplication in the time domain is
convolution in the frequency domain :
Y(ω) = (1/2π) F(ω) ∗ (πδ(ω + ω0) + πδ(ω − ω0))
Recall that
x(t) ∗ δ(t) = ∫_{−∞}^{∞} δ(τ) x(t − τ) dτ = x(t)
x(t) ∗ δ(t − t0) = ∫_{−∞}^{∞} δ(τ − t0) x(t − τ) dτ = x(t − t0)
So,
Y(ω) = (1/2) F(ω + ω0) + (1/2) F(ω − ω0)
